title: Prompt, punch-in send, agent thinks, result lands
summary: A white prompt pill types one request fast on a warm mesh gradient, holds, punches in on the send button for a slow cursor and a 3-frame press, then cuts to the chat: agent header, thinking lines, spinner, a code card and a shimmer.
use_when: An AI agent or assistant product that turns one prompt into a result
A short 5 s social loop or the opener of a longer AI product film
A light, warm consumer brand that wants the UI to feel soft and premium
Showing that the product is working without a progress bar

look.type_style: neutral grotesk, regular weight, sentence case, normal tracking; prompt 2 % H in the pill, 4 % H in the message bubble; thinking lines 2.5 % H grey; code card in small mono

sfx.event: each typed character in the prompt pill
agent header and thinking lines appear
shimmer sweep across the thinking lines

structure.shot: white pill input with a plus glyph, centred on a peach and lilac mesh gradient; one request types in, 39 chars
structure.camera: pill shifts left ~200 px @1920 in the first 8 fr (±0.25 s), then drift ≤ 0.3 px/fr; background blobs drift slowly
structure.motion: typing 1 char per frame (≈ 38 cps, f4 to f35, 31 fr), easings.linear, no caret; bar width constant

structure.shot: the full one-line request holds in the pill
structure.camera: drift ≤ 0.3 px/fr (motion.json pan 0,3 px/s, zoom 0.3 %/s); gradient keeps moving
structure.motion: hold 25 fr (f35 to f60), nothing enters; only the background mesh moves

structure.shot: close-up on the right end of the pill: black round send button with an up arrow; a hand cursor comes in and presses it
structure.camera: zoom-tier jump to detail (≈ 3×, button at 110 px of 720) at f60 with no transition, then near static (≤ 0.5 px/fr)
structure.motion: cursor enters from lower right f74 to f81, easings.outExpo 7 fr; rests 6 fr (f81 to f87); press f88 to f91 scale 1 → 0.84, easings.inQuad 3 fr (springs.click squash, release never shown)

structure.shot: chat layout: the request is now a white message bubble at the top; agent mark and name, then two grey status lines and a spinner line appear under it
structure.camera: static frame for the layout; slow push-in 1.2 %/s (motion.json 3 to 4 s)
structure.motion: bubble slides in from the top 4 fr (f91 to f95), springs.ui; agent header fades 0 → 1 over 4 fr at f101; status lines at f107, f109, f115, each fade 2 to 4 fr with 4 px rise, easings.outCubic; spinner open arc 270°, 24 fr per turn, easings.linear

structure.shot: a white result card grows under the status lines, then a short code block types in line by line; a bright band sweeps the status lines
structure.motion: card rect grows over 4 fr (f119 to f123), springs.layout (overshoot not measurable); code lines stream in at ≈ 1 line per 3 fr; shimmer band 1/3 line width sweeps left to right in 10 to 12 fr (f124 to f134), easings.linear, text at 55 % outside the band, period ≥ 25 fr

params.brand: any brand.json; accent drives the gradient blobs, fg the send button, display/text fonts the UI
params.content.prompt: one request, 30 to 45 chars, one line in the pill
params.content.agentName: name shown next to the mark in the agent header
params.content.status: 2 or 3 short status lines (3 to 5 words), the last one with the spinner
params.content.result: 4 to 6 short code or result lines typed into the card
params.timing.cps: typing speed, default 38 (reference); 30 for slower readers
params.timing.hold: frames the full prompt holds before the punch-in (default 25)
params.aspect: 16:9 | 1:1 | 9:16; the pill and the chat column recentre

notes: Measured at 30 fps by frame (human notes) and checked on the 4 fps sheets. One continuous take with two camera jumps the cut detector missed: 2.00 s punch-in on the send button, 3.03 s reframe to the chat. Speed contrast is the point: 38 cps typing, 25 fr hold, 7 fr cursor, 6 fr rest, 3 fr press, cut before the release. Status lines 2 to 6 fr apart. Shimmer sweep 10 to 12 fr over a ~240 px line at 720p. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent). Missing: a mesh-gradient background component, a growing code card; proposed term cut-on-press.
